_comment: TEST-PREP consumption of PRECON session_placeholders, pc-setup cluster, and ref downstream_hints personas. Playbook: .cursor/pipelines/test-prep.md. Verifier: test_prep_verify.py --strict-principal / --mode principal. Upstream: docs/epic-prep-principal-contract.json, docs/precon-principal-contract.json, docs/test-prep-topology-contract.json.

principal_load.emit: sources.principal_loaded true when precon sources.principal_loaded or ref downstream_hints personas / principal_coverage_threads consumed

setup_bundle_rules.when: precon test_skeleton row with precon_cluster_id pc-setup or bundle_id tb-setup
setup_bundle_rules.test_bundle: adopt tb-setup with precon_cluster_refs pc-setup; covers_check_ids from skeleton chk-s1 chk-s2 on 594 pairing

placeholder_paste_rules.copy_to: sources.session_placeholders from precon session_placeholders when principal_loaded
placeholder_paste_rules.dual_account: when ref needs_dual_account_contrast Actions or Preconditions MUST reference group_key_enrg and group_key_oppt tokens on setup or contrast bundles

persona_split_rules.map_check_to_personas: coverage obligations_coverage check_id to ref obligation downstream_hints.personas
persona_split_rules.split_when: bundle covers_check_ids mixes disjoint non-cross_persona personas e.g. retail and dealer

observation_precondition_order.rule: non-setup bundles first precondition references pc-setup completion when precon has pc-setup cluster then pc-001 cite

strict_test_prep_principal_verifier.skip_when: no precon sources.principal_loaded and no ref provision personas (639 metrics optional)
checks: when precon pc-setup: sources.principal_loaded true on tests
setup bundle precon_cluster_refs includes pc-setup covering chk-s1 chk-s2
dual-account placeholders in draft when ref needs_dual_account_contrast
retail-only and dealer-only primaries not in same bundle
validation_log phase1-principal and phase8b_principal_paste when principal active

CLOSE.use: Terminal cross-artifact principal lint (Round 2 step 8); close_verify.py --mode principal --strict-principal
